capture_scope.capture_deltas: Global torch.cuda allocated/reserved after capture minus before capture; these are net changes, not an isolated per-pool measurement.
capture_scope.negative_reserved_delta: A negative net reserved difference is an allocator-state change across the capture boundary, not negative Graph memory usage.

standalone_graph_pool_bytes.reason: No per-pool allocator snapshot or counter was captured. Pool identifiers and global net deltas are recorded; independent-process inference peaks include the retained graph.
